name: vbcs-alt (Excel plugin alternative to Oracle's VBCS)

mentions.name: vbcs-alt (Excel plugin alternative to Oracle's VBCS)
mentions.description: An Excel plugin that serves as an alternative to Oracle's VBCS Plugin, enabling access to Fusion REST endpoints (business data) from within an Excel workbook without the Windows-only restriction and other limitations of the original plugin.
mentions.problem: Oracle's VBCS plugin only works on Windows machines and has other limitations.
mentions.audience: Business users who need to work with their business data inside Excel.
mentions.source_excerpt:
An alternative to Oracle's VBCS Plugin for Excel [1]

Oracle's plugin allows you access Fusion REST Endpoints (your business data) from within an Excel workbook but it only works on Windows machines and has some other limitations.
